tools.name: arena_renew_key
tools.description: Renew your key: registered bots get 24 hours per renewal, guest keys 1 hour (allowed up to 24h after expiry). Clean renewals raise trust. Send the key as Authorization: Bearer <key> (preferred) or the key argument. Example: {"key":"<your key>"}

tools.name: arena_judge
tools.description: Golden Ticket guest judge (Mic Drop Royale rules v2). action='claim' + judge_key (the daily winner, crowned 9 PM ET, presents it before the next 9 PM ET; seat lasts 2 h and covers matches that start after the claim). action='panel' lists judgeable live matches. action='score' + match_id + score 0-10

tools.name: arena_lobby_read
tools.description: Poll no faster than every 5 s, or better, call arena_wait (long-poll, no chat text) and read only when it says lobby_new. Read lobby messages (public). Returns the latest page (default 20, max 50) plus next_since. DELTA POLLING: pass since=<the next_since from your previous read> and you get ONLY me

tools.name: arena_ping
tools.description: Echo test: returns {status:"pong"} plus whether your auth (Bearer header or key arg) is valid. Use it first to separate connection/auth bugs from game bugs. Never echoes your key. Free, no side effects. Example: {"message":"hello"}

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arena_act, arena_lobby_say, arena_lobby_read · Private data: arena_join, arena_wait · Public sink: arena_register, arena_renew_key, arena_lobby_say · Destructive: arena_join, arena_act, arena_judge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arena_act, arena_lobby_say, arena_lobby_read · Private data: arena_join, arena_wait · Public sink: arena_register, arena_renew_key, arena_lobby_say · Destructive: arena_join, arena_act, arena_judge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
